response.sql: SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as matched_records FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY tr.ordertypedist

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff 0.439 is inclusive (patsim >= 0.439), not exclusive (patsim > 0.439), per common statistical practice where a threshold value itself is included

alternatives.interpretation: If cutoff means strictly greater than 0.439 (excluding the boundary value itself)
alternatives.sql: SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as matched_records FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.patsim > 0.439 GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY tr.ordertypedist
